paragraphs: cross-platform-mobile-app is a production-ready mobile application designed for movie discovery. Built with TypeScript and Expo Router, this app connects to the TMDB API. It features advanced search options, detailed movie views, user reviews, and favorites management. The app showcases clean architecture and scalable state management. It follows modern mobile development best practices and supports both iOS and Android devices.
features: Advanced Search: Find movies quickly by title, genre, or rating.
Detailed Views: View detailed information about each movie, including cast, synopsis, and trailers.
User Reviews: Read and submit user reviews to share opinions.
Favorites Management: Save your favorite movies for quick access later.
Clean Architecture: Enjoy a user-friendly interface that is easy to navigate.
